summary: Integra Resources Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an updated Code of Business Conduct and Ethics as Exhibit 99.1, signed by CFO Andree St-Germain and dated October 30, 2026. The filing contains no transaction terms, no stakeholder percentages, no board recommendation on any deal, and no advisor engagement. The Code covers conflicts of interest, disclosure accuracy, anti-bribery compliance, confidentiality, asset protection and internal reporting, applying to employees, officers, directors and key consultants, plus expectations for agents and suppliers. This is a routine governance disclosure, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
